resources.string: Your work day, already written down.
Tarry quietly notes where you are during work hours, splits your day into on-site time and travel, and lets you drop jobs onto it later.
No account. No cloud. Your location stays on your phone unless you export it.
Not now, skip the remaining permissions and set your hours
Paint your hours once. Tarry starts and stops on its own.
Couldn\'t save your hours. Try again.
Tracking can\'t start until location is allowed all the time. Fix it in Settings → Tracking health.
Tracking may start late until exact alarms are allowed. Fix it in Settings → Tracking health.
Tarry starts and stops on its own. You can change your hours any time in Settings.
Tarry won\'t start on its own until you paint some hours in Settings. You can also turn tracking on from the Timeline.
